findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "defrr_create_contract" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Use when a new deal is signed and you need its revenue and billing schedule worked out from the terms, without saving it anywhere. Returns every month's billing…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: defrr_process_renewal · Private data: defrr_create_contract · Public sink: defrr_create_contract, defrr_create_waterfall, defrr_process_renewal, defrr_usage_billing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: defrr_process_renewal · Private data: defrr_create_contract · Public sink: defrr_create_contract, defrr_create_waterfall, defrr_process_renewal, defrr_usage_billing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
